description: This file defines the Subordinate class within the OrangeHRM system, which extends ListableDisplayField to customize report display fields specific to subordinate employees, including methods to return associated DTO class, relevant fields, and entity aliases.

classes.name: Subordinate
classes.description: Represents a subordinate employee display field for reports, specifying DTO class, relevant fields, and entity aliases.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of field identifiers relevant for subordinate employees.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in query building related to subordinate employees.
